steps.text: Outside the Rhodes Island Training Room

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Why are the lights in the training room still on at this hour?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Is someone in there? Woah... talk about a workaholic.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ah, Melantha, good evening! You're hard-working as ever.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Did you just finish training? It's so late... Doesn't it seem like the Reserve Team's training sessions have been running later and later?

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I'm glad that everyone is motivated, but your health should always come first.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Ah, um... thanks...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: It's okay though. Instructor Fallon has been managing my training regimen, so there won't be any accidents.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: I see. Oh, right, have you had dinner yet?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Not yet... But it's fine, please don't worry about me...

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: C'mon, don't be like that, you know how important it is to get your three meals!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: But that's easier said than done... The cafeteria might already be out of hot food, so if you want something fresh, you'll probably have to cook it yourself.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Is that something you can handle? Or, tell you what, how about I help out?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What's going on here? You two are blocking the way.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Oh, Instructor Dobermann!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Instructor Dobermann! Franka!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey girly~ Long time no see~

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: I didn't know you had so much time to make small talk, Klin. I assume you're already done with your work for the week?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: And what's more, you're offering to help cook for someone? Last time I checked, you still couldn't tell sugar from salt.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ahaha, c'mon now, Instructor Dobermann, there's no need to rub salt in the wound, right?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Just a reminder, Binns was looking for you a moment ago.

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Ehh? In that case, I'll be getting back to work then. Don't want to cause trouble, y'know. See you around, ahaha...!

steps.name: Logistics Operator
steps.text: Please don't tell the boss you saw me here!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hahaha! You Rhodes Island folk are so funny!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Embarrassing. Can't believe that guy's still acting like this... What a joke.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Melantha, Klin didn't do anything rude, did he? He's not a bad guy, but he is damn glib... If he's bothering you, feel free to ignore him.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: N-No, he was very nice.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Well, I guess that's fine then.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Of course. I'd be on my best behavior too if I bumped into such a cute li'l lady~

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Eh? Huh?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Stop it, you.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Belay that evil laugh. I don't want you spooking my trainees.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh my...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Instructor, you're the domineering type, aren't you? Mel, is she always this controlling?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: M-Mel? Um... N-No, Instructor Dobermann is very nice...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: She may be strict, but I've always thought...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Do you hear that? She's complimenting you, you absolute stud. Does that make you happy?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Enough joking around. Melantha, Fallon's already talked to you about the Reserve Op Team's formation this time around, right?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: After talking things over, we decided to make you the captain. If Reserve Op Team A4 has no issues with it, I'll bring you the paperwork that needs to be signed tomorrow.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So, let me in on a little secret. How many Reserve Op Teams do you guys have?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What makes you think I'd tell you that?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What's wrong with asking, on the off-chance your lips were feeling a little loose?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Trust me, I'm just a little curious. For an organization like Blacksteel, Rhodes Island could cultivate all the reserve teams it wants and we wouldn't feel threatened.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Makes sense that you'd prefer to train up your own teams than rely on outsiders. I get it.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh, but, you Reserve Team kids look like you've got some troubles.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: What is it, Melantha? Did you want to say something?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um, Instructor...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Is there not even any bread left...?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: (Admittedly, things ended up running a bit too late today, but there's no way around it...)

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: (The staff left a long time ago, and I couldn't possibly trouble others over something like this... Maybe I'll just bear it for the night and go to sleep earlier...)

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: *Sigh*...
What's wrong? Why are you standing here sighing all by yourself?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Eep!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Hwah!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Wh-Wh-Wh-What is it?! You scared me!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Oh... Merry, it's you.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Ehehe, that it is~

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: What are you doing over here? It's long past dinnertime, isn't it?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Oh, lemme guess, you haven't even eaten dinner yet? Are you hungry? Adnachiel made a whole bunch of sweets, and I was just looking for you! Let's eat together!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Oh right, right! There must be some good news since the Instructor kept you extra long today, right? Steward said you're gonna be our captain, is that true? And Steward also said—

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: —Gah!! Ah crap, I was supposed to keep that a secret!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Well, whatever, I already spilled the beans. Not like you can keep something this exciting under wraps anyway! So, is it true? I sure hope it's true!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Um... Merry, do you think I can handle it?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Instructor, I think... I'm not qualified to be the captain of Reserve Op Team A4.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I'm very sorry...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I hope Instructor Fallon and Instructor Dobermann will reconsider...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Woah, now I didn't expect this.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: The girl says she can't do it. What do you think?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: You're not gonna say anything? C'mon, why do all you serious types have to be so stuffy?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hey, Mel, who do you think is qualified to lead the team then?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Well, Steward thinks things through a lot better.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: During the last mock battle, we made three mistakes. Steward was the one who made up for them behind the scenes and won us a good final result. Everyone trusts him.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Ansel always pays close attention to our health, and he can often judge how we're doing and prepare appropriate measures even if we don't tell him anything.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Adnachiel, um, though I still can't tell what he's thinking, whenever we need firepower, he's always able to identify the needs of each teammate and launch attacks from the most suitable position.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Merry... Um, Cardigan, is energetic but not reckless. She always pays close attention to protecting the other members of the team during battle. Our formations are often centered around her.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I think all of them have what it takes to be a great captain!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: You know, everything you just said right now, is exactly what...

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Actually, never mind. I'll let you figure it out for yourself.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: In any case, I won't rescind our decision for the time being. We have our own decision-making process.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: But, Instructor!

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Let's set this conversation aside for now. I recommend that you think this over carefully, ideally talk to the rest of the team, and then give me your answer tomorrow.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: We won't interfere with your judgment. Whether you're fit for the job, whether you can do it or not, these are things that you have to decide for yourself.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: However, I will ask you this one question.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: Operator Melantha, what made you decide to go into combat?
I am familiar with the delicate and the aromatic.
I am familiar with the clear afternoon sun, the glistening of glass bottles, the rippling of smooth velvet, as well as other elegant, civilized niceties.
Of course I am familiar with these things, because this is how I spent much of my life.
But, I am not familiar with the blood-soaked battlefield.
Why did I step onto it?
Why did I choose to face such perils and assume such a heavy burden?
What is it...
What is it that I wanted?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Merry, I... am I cut out to be an operator?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: What the hell are you talking about?!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Huh? M-M-Merry, w-wait, calm down!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Wait, the table— Merry, stop pounding the table!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: What's important right now... isn't the freaking table!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: What do you mean 'cut out?' Melantha, why are you down on yourself? You're obviously the best, the cream of the crop!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Please don't say that, you know I'm not like that...

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Hmph! I hereby declare that you don't understand yourself at all, and that I know you better than you do! You're not allowed to say that you're not awesome!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: If you still don't know why you're so awesome, lemme lay it out for you!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: First, you're always there training with me and helping me test new defensive tactics! You're super nice!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Second, you're always helping me put together my equipment, and even though you've never mentioned it, don't think I haven't noticed! You're super thoughtful!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Third, you always bring us delicious snacks to eat! You know exactly what flavors we like! You're super sweet!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Fourth, you helped me tie the Instructor's hair into little pigtails when she wasn't looking! You're super fun to be around!

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: W-Wait, I never did that last thing!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Heh, see, nothing slips past you at all! Even Steward didn't catch that one last time.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: So, even if that last one was made up, the reality is that you're super awesome, and that is an undeniable fact!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Any other objections?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Are we done now? See, not a single one of us thinks that you aren't cut out to be the captain!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: But ultimately, it's your call. Melantha, what do you want to do?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: What I want to do...
Can I really do this?
Do I have the ability... to live up to everyone's expectations?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I... I might have areas where I'm not good enough, and there might be a lot of things I still have to learn...
But putting them aside, I... What do I want to do?
What is it that I want?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I want to be able to protect people. Not just be sheltered by my parents, struggling to communicate with my own family...

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: I'll give it my all! I'll do everything I can to become a worthy captain, and continue to grow alongside all of you.

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Merry, are you... okay with that?

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Isn't that what we've always been doing all this time?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Yes... Thank you, Merry.

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Mmhmm!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Ehehe, I'm so glad you're finally smiling!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Okay... Looks like there shouldn't be any issues, right?

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: They found the frozen food in the freezer and are heating it up now. What should I do with these sweets, Steward? Should I still hand them over?

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Why are we still hiding over here anyway?

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I don't think we're needed here. Hold up a sec, Adnachiel, Ansel. Don't head over there yet, let them be alone a bit longer.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: I don't think I've ever seen Miss Melantha smile so happily before.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: Steward's right. It'd be way too awkward if we just dropped in now.

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: But, knowing the way Cardigan does things...

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Woah! What's going on? Why's this thing not moving?

steps.name: Melantha
steps.text: Is this... the heating button? The connection seems a little loose, so maybe we should turn it this way...

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Don't worry, I got this. I know just the thing, since basically all machines work like this!

steps.name: Cardigan
steps.text: Heheh, watch and learn!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: ...She's definitely going to break the food heater.

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Please say something sooner next time!!

steps.name: Steward
steps.text: Wait, Cardigan, stop! Don't touch that switch! And stop banging on that knob! Melantha, hurry up and stop her!!

steps.name: Adnachiel
steps.text: Ahaha, it's too late. That thing's done for.

steps.name: Ansel
steps.text: *Sigh*... There's no stopping them from making a ruckus. Just don't get hurt over there, okay?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What's wrong, headache?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: ...Just a little.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Because your team ran up another bill for destroying a kitchen appliance? Or because of your new shy team captain?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: All of the above. Melantha still lacks confidence in herself.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh? Well, I don't think that's necessarily a bad thing either.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Compared to all those morons who have nothing but confidence without any of the skills to back it up, it's reassuring to be around some more cautious and reserved people, wouldn't you agree?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Plus, you heard what she said.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She's been paying close attention to every single member of her team. Is that not what a captain should do?

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It'd be great... if she recognized that.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Trust me, I'm never wrong about this stuff. Those kids are gonna be just fine~

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Ah, I just remembered! She uses a sword, right? How about, you give her to me for some training?
